answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a fresh per-epoch proof; standing then grows only as already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches wander back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters, bending like a willow but never rooting. Score the delta between claimed cross-cluster vouches and the real independent-root count; a wide delta slashes weight. Honest pays one anchor once; the farm pays a fresh anchor per head, linear.
